mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS levels and 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.5% indicate labor market overheating, triggering Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 2050 thousand units signals housing boom regime, driving consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In housing boom periods (HOUST > 2050), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher UNRATE reflects economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 120 indicates robust industrial expansion, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO > 120 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth > 1.5% combined with HOUST > 2050 signals broad economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth > 1.5% and HOUST > 2050, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months signals active monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening periods (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.
